Title: The most pool with a single action?

Messages.Author: Lemminkäinen
Messages.Body:
What's the most pool you can get with a single action (so no Journal of Hrorsh or Villeining a 100cap who has hunted himself full).

I can get to twenty - can you beat that?

Warning: Spoiler!

Unnamed, clan impersonated into Guruhi, ousts with a Legal Manipulations bleed using I am Legion and Edge of the World while a Political Flux for 12 has been voted through. So that's 2+1+1+4+12.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
I got 37 / 49.

Warning: Spoiler!

Lutz calls Ancient Influence with prey at 1 pool, grand prey at 6 pool, none of these two controlling a vampire, with Political Flux in play for 12, and Khabar: Glory.

EDIT: Add Khabar: Glory.

You can turn Lutz into a Guruhi if you want.
Play Bribes + Voter Captivaion.

That's 1 (bribes) + 2 (VC) + 6 (Ancient Influence) + 12 (first out) + 4 (Edge of the World) + 4 (Khabar: Glory) + 6 (second oust) +4 (Khabar: Glory) = 37.

Add 1 per discipline card on Lutz.

Eventually, if Lutz has turned Guruhi, you might also be playing some Oruns in your deck. If that's the case, say your grand predator calls the AI (which removes Bribes + VC + Edge of the World = 7 pool), you get 2 extra pool per Orun. That's, if you have 11 Oruns on Lutz, a total of 22 + 12 +4 + 6 + 4 = 48 pool. (49, if they play Bribes )

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
Actually, Pascal, even better if Lutz is not Guruhi, but Assamite.
He could then go Khabar: Glory, free untap from it, and then all things just as you made it, for a total of +4 more pool.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Notice that you just need to control Lutz in my scenario. You could have a Guruhi play Edge of the World, *and* Khabar: Glory in play. And your acting minion could be a Brujah.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Actually, there's better.

69

Warning: Spoiler!

K:G, PI (12) in play. You control Lutz and a Guruhi. Tension in the ranks is in play.

say your acting minion has CEL + POT, and calls the AI.

Your first prey has 1 pool. She blocks. in the combat, you play Torn Signpost, Hand strike, Pursuit for an additional strike, Torrent, Disarm. That's 12 + 4 pool. Play Edge of the World to cycle.
New prey blocks. Repeat for 10 pool.
No other blocks.
Your prey is ousted by Ancient Influence - 6 (oust) + 4 (KG) + 1 (Bribes) + 2 (VC) + 6 (AI)
Your new prey is ousted by Lutz (6 + 4).

You've won 20 + 10 + 19 + 10 = 69 pool.
Sadly, there's noone left to witness it

Messages.Author: Suoli
Messages.Body:
1. Play PB: Montreal and gain X pool.

2. Play Bounty with X pool.

3. Burn the vampire with Bounty to gain X+1 pool.

Pros:
- literally requires only 1 action, no Clan Impersonating or other setup actions
- infinite pool gain

Cons:
- converts pool gained by Montreal into pool gained by an action, which could be considered pool laundering
